## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Vipākattika* (Patthana 19.3) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Bibliographically, it treats the triad of karmic resultants (*vipāka-ttika*, or "the triad 'karmically resultant, etc.'"), which constitutes the third triad of the Abhidhamma *mātikā* matrix systematically applied throughout the combinatorial sections of the *Paṭṭhāna* [Nyanatiloka 2007].
No ancient external parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are recorded for this text [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive Pali-internal text reuse, identifying 125 matching passages shared across 34 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. This internal reuse reflects the highly repetitive combinatorial structure of the *Paṭṭhāna*, sharing major textual blocks with other treatments of the *Vipākattika* triad—particularly *Vipākattika* (Patthana 1.4; 23 matches, 5,460 shared characters) and *Vipākattika* (Patthana 13.3; 8 matches, 2,664 shared characters)—as well as dyad-triad combinations including *Hetuduka, Tika* (Patthana 3.1), *Vipākattika, Hetuduka* (Patthana 16.27 and 22.18), and *Kusalattika, Vipākattika* (Patthana 11.2, 17.2, and 23.2) [DharmaNexus].
**Parallels and text reuse**

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Vipākattika (Patthana 1.4) (§1.1–3.1_0 ↔ §80.1–82.1_1); Vipākattika (Patthana 13.3) (§1.1–3.1_1 ↔ §2.1_4–3.1_4); Hetuduka, Tika (Patthana 3.1) (§2.1–3.1_1 ↔ §245.1–247.1); Vipākattika, Hetuduka (Patthana 16.27) (§1.1–2.1 ↔ §1.1_5–2.1_2); Vipākattika, Hetuduka (Patthana 22.18) (§0.1–3.1_1 ↔ §0.1–3.1_1); Kusalattika, Vipākattika (Patthana 11.2) (§1.1–2.1 ↔ §1.1_0–1.1_3); Tika Hetuduka (Patthana 4.1) (§1.1–3.1_1 ↔ §143.1_3–146.1); Mahantaraduka, Kusalattika (Patthana 3.10) (§2.1–3.1_1 ↔ §190.1–191.1_2)
